rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a fisherman, especially someone who fishes for a living.

example.english: That fisherman goes out to sea every day to make a living.
example.traditional: 嗰個打魚佬日日出海搵食。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 daa2 jyu4 lou2 jat6 jat6 ceot1 hoi2 wan2 sik6

rows.note: Use this for a fisherman viewed as part of the fishing community or occupation.

example.english: The government is helping the fisherman community improve its typhoon-shelter facilities.
example.traditional: 政府幫漁民改善避風塘設施。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 bong1 jyu4 man4 goi2 sin6 bei6 fung1 tong4 cit3 si1

rows.note: Use this more formal or literary word for an individual fisherman.

example.english: In the poem, the fisherman sails along the river.
example.jyutping: si1 zung1 jyu4 fu1 faan6 zau1 gong1 soeng6

rows.note: Use this written or literary term when referring generally to a person who fishes.

example.english: Literary works often use the fisherman as a symbol of freedom.
example.traditional: 文學作品常以漁人象徵自由。
example.jyutping: man4 hok6 zok3 ban2 soeng4 ji5 jyu4 jan4 zoeng6 zing1 zi6 jau4
